svg.aria-label: GET /healthz: Liveness of the process. GET /readyz: Readiness. postgres and nats are critical. GET /v1/health: The snapshot as one JSON document. GET /v1/health/stream: SSE: snapshot first, then status per change, : ping every 15 s. Max 50 streams, then 503. 1 h lifetime. local edge: http://127.0.0.1:8080/pulse/v1/health/stream
